bio: I'm a 4th-year Computer Science student at Biliran Province State University, on the path to becoming a Data Analyst with a growing focus on networking. I'm currently a scholar in Google's Data Analytics program on Coursera, and I've completed Cisco Networking Academy's Networking Basics. Along the way I've built web systems that solve real local problems — MushGuard, an AI-powered mushroom identifier for Biliranons, and BiPSU SRMS, a scholarship records and eligibility platform for my university.
